Although Herschel continued to describe his new object as a comet, other astronomers had already begun to suspect otherwise. Finnish-Swedish astronomer [Anders Johan Lexell](/wiki/Anders_Johan_Lexell "Anders Johan Lexell"), working in Russia, was the first to compute the orbit of the new object.[[37]](#cite_note-lexell-43) Its nearly circular orbit suggested that it was a planet rather than a comet. Berlin astronomer [Johann Elert Bode](/wiki/Johann_Elert_Bode "Johann Elert Bode") described Herschel's discovery as "a moving star that can be deemed a hitherto unknown planet-like object circulating beyond the orbit of Saturn".[[38]](#cite_note-44) Bode concluded that its near-circular orbit was more like a planet's than a comet's.[[39]](#cite_note-45)

The object was soon accepted as a new planet. By 1783, Herschel acknowledged this to Royal Society president [Joseph Banks](/wiki/Joseph_Banks "Joseph Banks"): "By the observation of the most eminent Astronomers in Europe it appears that the new star, which I had the honour of pointing out to them in March 1781, is a Primary Planet of our Solar System."[[40]](#cite_note-Dreyer-46) In recognition of his achievement, [King George III](/wiki/George_III_of_the_United_Kingdom "George III of the United Kingdom") gave Herschel an annual [stipend](/wiki/Stipend "Stipend") of £200 (equivalent to £26,000 in 2025)[[41]](#cite_note-inflation-UK-47) on condition that he move to [Windsor](/wiki/Windsor,_Berkshire "Windsor, Berkshire") so that the Royal Family could look through his telescopes.[[42]](#cite_note-Miner12-48)

Seven out of the eight Ivy League schools are [Colonial Colleges](/wiki/Colonial_colleges "Colonial colleges"): institutions of higher education founded prior to the [American Revolution](/wiki/American_Revolution "American Revolution"). Cornell, the exception to this commonality, was founded immediately after the [American Civil War](/wiki/American_Civil_War "American Civil War"). These seven colleges served as the primary institutions of higher learning in [British America](/wiki/British_America "British America")'s [Northern](/wiki/New_England "New England") and [Middle Colonies](/wiki/Middle_Colonies "Middle Colonies").
